ios.desc:
Aim for your miss, not a miracle.

Most strokes aren't lost to bad swings. They're lost to bad targets: pins you were never going to hit. Golf Playbook shows you where to aim, and where it's safe to miss, on every hole. Free, with an AI caddie in your pocket.

The features other apps charge $150/year for, we built free.

WHAT MAKES US DIFFERENT
Any golf app can tell you it's 156 yards to the pin. Golf Playbook tells you the play: for your game, in this wind, the smart target is 15 yards left of it. Not just how far. Where.

We built our course intelligence from raw open terrain data: every risk zone, every contour, from the ground up. That's why we can do things no other app can:

• Color-coded risk zones (patent pending): see where's safe and where's trouble for YOUR game, on every hole. Red, amber, green, computed from the terrain and your real misses. Nowhere else, free or paid.
• Weather-compensated shot patterns: the honest shape of where your shots land, adjusted for wind, slope, temperature, and altitude.
• AI Caddie: on-device intelligence (Apple Intelligence) that reasons about the hole, not just the yardage. Private. Works offline.
• Club-to-target fit: see instantly whether your shot pattern covers the target, or brings trouble into play.
• Aim lines: your draw and fade, drawn right on the hole.

The result: you stand on every tee already knowing the shot.

CREATE - PLAY - REVIEW
CREATE your playbook before the round. Pick your course, set your clubs from your 7-iron distance, and get a hole-by-hole strategy with risk zones, dispersion overlays, and club recommendations.

PLAY with a live scorecard and your AI Caddie in your pocket. Record shots from your lock screen with one tap.

REVIEW every shot on the map, refine your playbook, and share it by QR code or link.

PRINT YOUR OWN YARDAGE BOOK
Turn any playbook into a pocket-sized PDF yardage book: your strategy, on paper, in the bag. (Premium course-branded books are available through partner courses.)

TOURNAMENT READY
Switch weather compensations off for conforming play, and keep your strategy, aim lines, and notes. Lock in your plan before the round.

WHY IT'S FREE
Golf is a beautiful game. Strategy shouldn't cost $150/year.

We built our terrain data from OpenStreetMap, and our AI runs on your device, so what costs other companies millions to operate costs us almost nothing.

The college kid who can't afford a shot-tracking subscription. The weekend player who won't pay for premium tiers. T

quotes.text:
I created a free golf app with advanced visualization none of the paid apps have.

New in the latest release: you can print your personalized Playbook at home (print, cut, fold, staple).

I've been playing on a national amateur golf tour for over ten years.
Before each event, I'd spend hours on Google Earth — figuring out where to aim on every hole and which club to hit. It got very cumbersome very soon.
I wanted a tool that did the spatial reasoning for me. Take my dispersion, the wind, the elevation, the hazards — and just show me the right line on a flyover. Visually, not in numbers.

So I built Golf Playbook (iOS).

Free, no subscription. Built our course data from OpenStreetMap instead of licensing an expensive commercial database. Different cost structure, different price.

Tech: SwiftUI, Apple Foundation Models, OpenStreetMap data. Many nights and weekends.
Always looking for feedback.

App: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/golf-playbook-strategy-gps/id1557162395

Website: https://playbook.golf
